variable.title: Variables
variable.sheet-description: Values that pages reference by key, and the ones you set for them

intro.normal: Pages use these values by their key, for example in metric charts and queries. The values you pick here apply only to you.
intro.edit: Groups and variables are shared with everyone. Only their values are personal.

by-page-tooltip.on-now: Variables used on this page are shown first, in their own section.
by-page-tooltip.on-click: Click to list all variables together.
by-page-tooltip.off-click: Click to show the ones used on this page first.

actions.show-one-list: Show all variables in one list

builtin.tag-hint: These variables are always present and available on every page
builtin.form-notice: Metric charts can follow this built-in variable instead of a fixed setting. Name, key, group and type can't change, but the default value can.

empty.builtin-only-title: No variables of your own yet
empty.builtin-only-description: Add your own to reuse a value such as an environment, a region or a release across pages.
empty.no-groups-title: No groups of your own yet
empty.no-groups-description: Groups keep related variables together under one color.

variable-form.key-hint: Reference it in queries and text as {reference}
variable-form.key-invalid: Start with a letter and use only lowercase letters, digits and underscores
variable-form.options-hint: The first option is the default. Drag to reorder.
variable-form.default-empty-hint: Used when the field is left empty
variable-form.delete-hint: References on pages will show as {reference}

group-form.name-taken: Another group already uses this name
group-form.delete-blocked-hint: Move or delete its variable first | Move or delete its {count} variables first
group-form.delete-clean-hint: It has no variables, so it can be deleted cleanly

deletion-modal.variable-description: {name} will be deleted for everyone. References on pages will show as {reference}.
deletion-modal.group-empty: {name} has no variables, so it can be deleted cleanly.
deletion-modal.group-blocked: {name} still holds {count} variable. Move or delete it before you delete the group. | {name} still holds {count} variables. Move or delete them before you delete the group.

editing-toast.title: Your variables aren't saved yet
editing-toast.description: Finish editing them before you open the inbox.
